info.name: A list of two hundred hours with the highest generation

params.name: capacityYearId
params.description: Format - int32. ID of the capacity year to query (eg 2017)

items.docs:
This returns a CSV with a header and two hundred subsequent rows, representing the intervals of the highest periods of generation in the capacity market and the corresponding generation quantity (in MW). Eg:
           
           
           Hour Interval,Value
           12/01/2016 14:30,35037.00
           15/01/2016 13:00,35033.00
           ...
